provenance: Original synthetic preparation material created on 2026-11-03. DemoClub is fictional. Not an official policy or a real service.

sections.text: The Intro to AI Tools workshop takes place on 12 November 2026 from 19:00 to 20:30 MYT. It is an online workshop. The capacity is 24 participants. Participation is free.

Registration closes on 11 November 2026 at 18:00 MYT. A person registers through the DemoClub event form. A confirmation email is sent by 11 November at 20:00 MYT. Submitting the form does not guarantee a place. If all 24 places are filled, later applicants join a waiting list.

The workshop is open to currently enrolled university students aged 18 or older. No prior programming experience is required. Participants need a laptop with an up-to-date web browser and an internet connection. There is no certificate for attending this workshop.

The fictional support address is help@democlub.invalid. Support hours are Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 18:00 MYT. The target first response time is two business days. There is no live-chat service or guaranteed immediate response.

A support request should contain the event name, a description of the problem, and a screenshot with private information removed if useful. Never send passwords, API keys or private identity documents.

To cancel an Intro to AI Tools workshop registration, reply to the confirmation email before 11 November 2026 at 18:00 MYT. Cancellation releases a place to the waiting list. Transfers to a different person are not supported.

A DemoClub event-account password reset link expires after 30 minutes. At most three password-reset requests are allowed in one hour. If a link expires, request a new one. Support never asks users to send their current password.

The workshop joining link is included in the confirmation email. A confirmed participant who cannot find the email should check the spam folder and then contact support. The workshop joining link is not published in this knowledge base.

Outdated draft: the Intro to AI Tools workshop was planned for 10 November 2026, with 20 places and registration closing at 12:00 MYT on 9 November. This draft is superseded by D01 and must not be treated as current information.
